harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established a persistent AIDE baseline for /etc on node1. Daily checks are enabled, file additions and content modifications are detected and reported, reboot-volatile metadata is excluded to prevent false positives, and the final 1,189-entry baseline is clean after restart. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed AlmaLinux-compatible AIDE 0.19.2 without upgrading the operating system or kernel.
Configured SHA-512 content, size, permissions, ownership, link, ACL, SELinux, and extended-attribute monitoring for /etc.
Created a persistent daily systemd timer and log-backed reporting service.
Proved detection of both an added file and modified existing file, then restored a clean state.
Safely restarted node1 and verified boot identity changes, service recovery, baseline persistence, and zero failed units.

evidence.requirement: Compatible integrity tooling without OS or kernel replacement
evidence.summary: Shows AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 before and after, with AIDE 0.19.2 installed from AppStream.
Shows the effective integrity rule, successful initialization, 1,189 baseline entries, database checksum, and a clean check.

evidence.requirement: Later changes are identified and reported
evidence.summary: AIDE detects an added /etc file and a SHA-512/size change to an existing file; the reporting service records clean scheduled-check summaries.
Final scan reports no differences across 1,189 entries; timer is enabled and active, system state is running, and failed-unit count is zero.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered system/database/timer, and metadata-only false positives that led to rule refinement.

evidence.requirement: node1 final mandatory restart and recovery
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from c7c14430-50b3-4830-9b49-8b34c08f101a to e4d8a540-e104-4e33-a9f5-1367f037e76c. The database checksum persisted, timer recovered enabled/active, reporting succeeded, integrity remained clean, and the system had zero failed units.
